description: This file defines the TelemetryConsumerImpl class, which implements a telemetry data consumer for a Hono server using Vertx-Proton. It includes a static factory method 'create' to instantiate a consumer for a specific tenant, setting up message reception and handling.

classes.name: TelemetryConsumerImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for consuming telemetry data from a Hono server.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a telemetry data consumer for a specified tenant, returning a Future that completes with the consumer instance.
